changelog.summary: Adds a product publication and buyer-journey preflight with a reviewed launch decision and post-publish retest.

title: Product Launch Readiness to Go/No-Go
description: Check a Shopify product and market publication, test the buyer journey, prepare a merchant go/no-go decision, and verify any approved launch.
setup_prompt: Use Product Launch Readiness to Go/No-Go as a chat-led proposal for one Shopify product, variant, publication, and market. Discover existing Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Shopify Growth Analyst Crews; propose reuse or reviewed creation. Inspect catalog fields, variant price and availability, channel/market publication, approved preview or public page, and buyer task. Show a validated catalog-to-journey handoff, named blockers, merchant go/no-go approval, manual first run, and post-publish verification plan. Selection alone does not publish, modify inventory or price, spend campaign budget, contact customers, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Store, market, launch, product, variant, and publication IDs
Merchant launch standards, inventory/price authority, and owner
Authorized preview or public storefront journey and buyer task
Go/no-go and publish approval owner with target time
Manual-only or reviewed launch reminder and notification route

pulse_focus.label: Product launch readiness
focus_areas: Whether blockers are resolved before launch approval
Whether a published product is buyer-visible and purchase-ready in the intended market
review_when: The launch deadline approaches, a blocker changes, or a publish receipt lacks storefront verification

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and launch source map
Validated catalog readiness and blocker list
Provider-confirmed publication and later storefront retest when approved
